subject: Social Media
title: R-Naught for Content
description: Learn R-Naught for Content in one minute.

hook.text: COVID had an R0 of 2–3: each infected person spread it to two or three others. Content works the same.

buildup.text: In epidemiology, R0 measures spread rate. If R0 exceeds 1, the virus grows. Below 1, it dies.

discovery.text: Content has its own R0. If each viewer causes more than one share on average, the post goes viral.

twist.text: Most content has an R0 near zero. You see it, feel nothing, and scroll past. No spread at all.

climax.text: Viral hits often have R0 above 2. The Ice Bucket Challenge peaked at an estimated R0 of 3.5.

punchline.text: Below one, it dies. Above one, it spreads.

quiz.question: What does an R0 above 1 mean for content?
options: Each viewer generates more than one new share
